title: 有馬記念の後に・有馬の顔は……

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having achieved her goal of overtaking Tokai Teio and winning the Arima Kinen, Nice Nature sheds tears of joy.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: In the post-race press interview, a reporter asks Nice Nature what led to her victory, and she answers that it was because she gave the race her all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She declares that she will never let her fans down so long as they continue to support her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Nice Nature now radiates confidence, having become the shining main character in her own right.
